Cursor.description:
Where a listing goes on from, as the last call's `next` gave it: pass it back as it
was.

feature.description: The feature whose solid the last entry listed is of.

name.description: The last entry listed, by its own name.

revision.description: The revision the listing is of: a cursor of another is refused, as a `conflict`.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

ModelChoice.description: Which model to read: the current one, or the newest published.

oneOf.description:
The session's current revision's model, rebuilt if it isn't yet: what an agent that
just edited reads.

The newest model published, which may be an older revision's, read at once: what a
UI reads while a rebuild runs.

request.description:
`elements`' request: a page of the model's elements, of one feature's solid or of
every body.

after.description: Where to go on from: null to start, else the last call's `next`.

feature.description:
The feature whose solid to list, or null for every body (the solids no later
feature consumed, in timeline order).

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

request.title: ElementsRequest

Alias.description: One of an element's other names.

stable.description: Whether this name is stable: one a reference stored in the document may use.

Angle.description: An angle in degrees: a number, to at most 9 decimals (nanodegrees). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

AxisToken.description: A global axis, signed, as a sketch on a face names its x.

Cursor.description:
Where a listing goes on from, as the last call's `next` gave it: pass it back as it
was.

feature.description: The feature whose solid the last entry listed is of.

name.description: The last entry listed, by its own name.

revision.description: The revision the listing is of: a cursor of another is refused, as a `conflict`.

ElementKind.description: What an element is: a face, an edge, or a vertex.

ElementType.description: An element's geometry, as OCCT names it. A face is a plane, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, bezier, bspline, revolution, extrusion, offset, or other; an edge a line, circle (an arc too), ellipse, hyperbola, parabola, bezier, bspline, offset, or other (a degenerated edge, such as a sphere's pole, is other); a vertex a point.

Entry.description:
A face, an edge, or a vertex, named and measured. Every field is always present, null
where it doesn't apply to the element's kind and type.

aliases.description: Its other names, in the element map's order, each with its own stability.

apex.description:
A cone's apex; null for a cone so nearly a cylinder that its apex lies further than a
length holds.

axis.description: A cylinder's, cone's, sphere's, torus's, circle's, or arc's axis.

default_x.description: For a planar face, the axis a sketch on it takes as its x by default.

diameter.description: Twice the radius: a circle's or arc's, and a cylinder face's.

feature.description: The feature whose solid the element is of.

half_angle.description:
A cone's half-angle in degrees, keeping its sign, as FreeCAD's `Part.Cone.SemiAngle`
gives it.

length.description: An edge's length (0 for a degenerated edge).

major_radius.description: A torus's major radius (FreeCAD's Toroid MajorRadius).

name.description:
The element's own name, the first of its names: give it to a fillet's `edges` (if
it's stable), `distance`, `angle`, or `render`'s `highlight`.

normal.description: A planar face's outward unit normal.

radius.description: A cylinder's, sphere's, circle's, or arc's radius.

stable.description:
Whether `name` is stable: false for a name that came about for more than one
element, a duplicate (`~n`), or an element by its number. A reference stored in the
document refuses an unstable name; use a stable alias.

start.description:
An edge's first end, in its curve's own order (FreeCAD's `Edge.firstVertex()`), not
the order a face uses it in.

straight.description: Whether an edge is straight: a line, or a degree-1 B-spline of two poles.

EntryAxis.description: An axis: a point on it and its direction, a unit vector keeping its surface's own sign.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

Length.description: A length in millimetres: a number, to at most 6 decimals (nanometres). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

Measure.description: A volume (mm³) or area (mm²): a number, to at most 6 decimals.

elements.description:
The entries, in order: by body in timeline order, then faces, edges, and vertices,
each by name, byte by byte.

next.description:
Where the next page starts: null after the last, and for a listing of every body of
a model whose rebuild met a kernel fault.

total.description: How many entries the listing holds in all, on every page.
